snapshot.text: Mixed system with the Regional Health Service (RGD), the State Health Fund (SZF) and private insurers, under financial strain. The ministry's 2026 NCD plan focuses on prevention, integrated care and better monitoring.

priorities.title: NCD plan 2026
priorities.text: Prevention, integrated care and better monitoring of non-communicable diseases.

priorities.title: Hospital financing
priorities.text: The health minister argues for a daily hospital rate of US$200.
